title: Local convergence analysis of a linearized Alikhanov scheme for the time fractional sine-Gordon equation
summary: This paper investigates the time fractional sine-Gordon equation whose solution exhibits a weak singularity of type t^α. By means of the Alikhanov formula we derive a fully discrete, linearized scheme. Using the more general regularity assumption, we derive a sharp truncation-error bound for the fractional derivative. Furthermore, we prove a key inequality and a less restrictive stability result that is valid on general graded temporal meshes. Consequently, the temporal local convergence order is shown to be min{2, r} in H^1-seminorm, where r is the degree of grading; numerical experiments…
